description: Natural-language job search for multi-constraint requests. Use this when the user wants jobs based on combinations such as remote work, salary, location, schedule, experience level, work style, Examples: 'a relaxed, well-paying job in Boston', 'a low-stress remote job with good pay'. If the request mentions a city, pay, or a relaxed/low-stress/remote preference, use this tool even when a skill is also mentioned. Do not use this for simple one-skill job questions like 'What jobs use Excel?' or 'What careers can I get with bookkeeping?'

query.description: Natural language job search query (full sentence allowed).

name: nlp_search
